name: Slink
description: A self-hosted image sharing platform built with Symfony and SvelteKit️.

paths.name: Local Storage - Image Path
paths.description: Path to store images. Remove if not using local storage.

variables.name: Require User Approval
variables.description: Whether to require user approval before they can upload images

variables.name: Allow Unauthenticated Users
variables.description: Whether to allow unauthenticated users to access public routes

variables.name: Minimum Password Length
variables.description: Minimum password length required for users

variables.name: User Password Requirements
variables.description: Bitmask of password requirements. Sum of the following options: 1 (numbers), 2 (lowercase), 4 (uppercase), 8 (special characters).

variables.name: Maximum Image Size
variables.description: Maximum image size allowed to be uploaded, in MB. Cannot be more than 50M.

variables.name: Strip EXIF Data
variables.description: Whether to strip EXIF metadata from the uploaded images

variables.name: Storage Provider
variables.description: Storage provider to use for storing images

variables.name: SMB Storage - Host
variables.description: SMB host to connect to. Remove if not using SMB storage.

variables.name: SMB Storage - Share
variables.description: SMB share to connect to. Remove if not using SMB storage.

variables.name: SMB Storage - Username
variables.description: SMB username to connect with. Remove if not using SMB storage.

variables.name: SMB Storage - Password
variables.description: SMB password to connect with. Remove if not using SMB storage.

variables.name: S3 Storage - Region
variables.description: Amazon S3 region to connect to. Remove if not using S3 storage.

variables.name: S3 Storage - Bucket
variables.description: Amazon S3 bucket to connect to. Remove if not using S3 storage.

variables.name: S3 Storage - Access Key ID
variables.description: Amazon S3 access key ID to connect with. Remove if not using S3 storage.

variables.name: S3 Storage - Secret Access Key
variables.description: Amazon S3 secret access key to connect with. Remove if not using S3 storage.
